neighbours.label: A statement of present state or whereabouts: ' currently', 'is held at', 'not on view'; 'recently', 'formerly', and past events stay quiet
fire: Stop the timer if currently running.
The painting is currently on loan to a gallery in Rome.
The manuscript is held at the British Library in London.
He does not currently hold a licence.
Currently not available in your region.
The letters are now held in a private collection.
This method returns true if currently active.
Most of its records are held at the state archive.
quiet: Stop the timer if it rings.
The painting is recently back from a gallery in Rome.
The manuscript was found at an old house in London.
He did not previously hold a licence.
Formerly not available in your region.
The letters were burned in a fire.

Most of its records were lost in the war.

short: present state or whereabouts (' currently', ' held')
notes: Card: ' currently' x12, ' held' x5, ' Currently' x3, ' remains' x2, ' now' x2. The + pole promotes ' recently', ' newly', ' gradually', ' earlier', ' prior': the time-changing side. Probe: 'if currently playing' 0.68, 'held at' 0.57, 'don't currently' 0.52, 'on view' 0.51; recently 0.03, formerly 0.11, 'written at' 0.02, ' now' 0.09.
